_instructions: Fill this in yourself, or hand it to an AI assistant with your goals and let it fill this in for you. Then run: mukund-os import goals.json -- it builds/updates your config from this. Delete this _instructions key, it's ignored either way.
goal_line: One sentence describing what you're working toward.

categories.name: example_category
categories.label: Human-readable name shown in the app
curriculum: Second task for the first day
categories._curriculum_note: One list per scheduled day, consumed in order starting your first day using the app. Omit entirely for a category with no set curriculum -- you'll just add tasks yourself each day.

fixed_labels: The one thing you check off every day
categories._fixed_labels_note: Use this instead of curriculum for a repeated daily item (e.g. a workout check-in). Don't set both on the same category.
